text: Two questions to tell you exactly why you're scrolling right now.
You're not doing it because you're tired.
You're doing it to get distracted.
To get distracted from something you know you need to do and you don't want to do it.
There is a reason why you're not doing it.
Despite that pain, why are you still going to do that?
Why it is so important that you're still going to do that even you know why it hurts?
Close your Instagram and see you tomorrow.
